incomplete_migration.issue_character: The codebase has several stalled mid-flight migrations where a newer implementation was written alongside the old one but the old one was never removed: two parallel TUI renderer stacks (legacy vs. new), two parallel file_tree implementations (colony-exec internal vs. colony-filetree crate), and two parallel goal tracking implementations (colony-exec internal vs. colony-focus crate) — plus a dead backward-compat shim (ToolHandler) and a dead type alias (ShopOptions).
incomplete_migration.score_rationale: The repository sits below the midpoint for this dimension. There are at least three distinct cases of old-and-new API coexistence producing real maintenance surface: the colony-tui legacy/new renderer split is actively called in production code; the colony-exec file_tree and goals modules are fully functional duplicates of standalone crates that the rest of the system has already adopted. A dead backward-compatibility trait (ToolHandler) with no implementations rounds out the picture. The WordPart::CommandSub legacy AST node being matched alongside CommandSubRaw in expander code is a smaller but active dual-path. These are not guarded behind feature flags or clearly time-boxed, which reduces confidence that they will be cleaned up organically.

root_causes: Two root cause clusters: (1) stalled_refactor — new crate or module was built alongside the old one but the old path was never deleted (colony-tui renderers, file_tree, goals, CommandSub AST node); (2) dead_compat_shim — backward-compatibility declarations added speculatively but never consumed (ToolHandler trait, ShopOptions alias)

colony-exec appears to have originally developed its own file_tree and goals subsystems before dedicated standalone crates (colony-filetree, colony-focus) were extracted; once those crates existed, colony-exec was not updated to adopt them
likely_symptoms: dual_file_tree_impl and dual_goals_impl are likely symptoms of colony-exec being an earlier, monolithic execution layer that predates the crate extraction pattern used by the rest of the project
possible_false_positives: colony-cloud-sdk OpenAI-compatible format (models.rs comment 'These types follow OpenAI's API format for compatibility') is intentional external-protocol alignment, not an incomplete migration
